name: Venus Kaiserin
source:
Venus is the deuteragonist of the story. She is part of the prestigious Kaiserin family. Venus is a shut in and didn't finished school or Kaiserin special training. Despite this, she is an acclaimed illustrator and drummer in indie spaces.
Venus believes she can control time and space. She's also obsessed with obscure space and time theories, insisting in proving their existence.

[Edited from [url=https://twitter.com/witchnovel88/status/1543586637128556546/photo/1]Twitter[/url]]
